Name: HeartKit seg-4-tcn-lg
Summary: Single-lead TCN emitting per-sample none/P/QRS/T over 2.56 s frames.

Model properties.Input: single-lead ECG, 256 samples (2.56 s) at 100 Hz

x-mival.notes: unverified: sha256 of model.keras (Ambiq S3 model zoo), keras version. No paper; docs only. BSD-3-Clause. Intended for wearables. A 10 s ECG needs sliding 256-sample windows; duration_s 2.56 makes the compiler crop to one window. 10 ms resolution is coarse for interval measurement. x-mival.output is the nearest existing value and is wrong in meaning.

windowing.note: one record -> several frames -> stitched mask
